entries.content: Social notes for Brightside Fixtures: Hiveku went live for social at the end of May 2026. Pillar targets agreed in June are Educate 40 / Authority 25 / Connection 20 / Promotion 15. Cadence is five posts a week across LinkedIn and Facebook, X on top when it works. Branded tag #BrightsideBuilt. Showroom open Saturdays. Instagram connected 2026-08-25; the first two posts went out the same week.
